events.title: Sandy Hook Lighthouse Tours
events.description: Tours are first come first served. Visitors are guided up 95 steps and a 9-rung ladder to the lantern room. Children must be 48 inches or taller to climb. Each tour is approximately 30 minutes long.
events.details:
Tours are first come first served. Visitors are guided up 95 steps and a 9-rung ladder to the lantern room. Children must be 48 inches or taller to climb. Each tour is approximately 30 minutes long.

Tour signups start at 12:30 in the Sandy Hook Visitor Center.

events.title: Sandy Hook History House
events.description: Built in 1898 and designated a lieutenant’s quarters on Officers Row, History House is furnished to the WWII era, the busiest time in the fort’s history. Enjoy this unique experience at your own pace
events.details: Built in 1898 and designated a lieutenant’s quarters on Officers Row, History House is furnished to the WWII era, the busiest time in the fort’s history. Enjoy this unique experience at your own pace with a self-guided tour.

events.title: Sandy Hook Harbor Defense Lantern Tour
events.description: Take a walk with volunteer living historians in uniform as World War II coast artillery soldiers from the park’s philanthropic partner, Army Ground Forces Association (AGFA). Visit several seacoast gu
events.details: Take a walk with volunteer living historians in uniform as World War II coast artillery soldiers from the park’s philanthropic partner, Army Ground Forces Association (AGFA). Visit several seacoast gun batteries of Fort Hancock and explore the restored Battery Gunnison/New Peck Battery. Visit http://armygroundforces.org/new-events.htm for more event information, historic documents, and audio downloads. Bring a flashlight
